evidence.quote: Current Study View Our Manual Contact Us Request a Presentation Understand the study with our team. › Publications View our latest research and publications. › For Collaborators Partner with our team on research initiatives. › Current Study Hoarding Treatment Study A research study evaluating an evidence-based treatment for older adults struggling with clutter and hoarding. ✓ For adults age 55+ ✓ In-person or telehealth options ✓ Compensation provided Learn More About the Study New Resource NEW: Client Treatment Manual Our newly updated client-facing Cognitive Rehabilitation and Exposure Sorting Therapy (CREST) manual is now available. View the Manual Resources Clinician & Community Resources Information for professionals, organizations, and community partners interested in hoarding disorder and treatment implementation. View Resources Catherine Ayers, Ph.D., ABPP Catherine Ayers, Ph.D., ABPP, is a Professor in the Department of Psychiatry at the University of California, San Diego (UCSD). Her research focuses on advancing the characterization of hoarding disorder and developing, evaluating, and implementing community-based behavioral interventions for older adults. Her recent work emphasizes personalized treatment, digital delivery, coordinated community responses, and interventions designed to improve everyday functioning among older adults with hoarding disorder. Over 100 peer-reviewed publications (Funded by NIH, VA, IOCDF and County of San Diego)
